description: The transcripts of Totonac Resources. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are the Totonac ELAN annotation files, whose location in the archive is not settled, inside archives that total about 4 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
